2607.29559.title: LEMUR: Learning to Align with Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning from Preference Feedback
2607.29559.paper_summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) systems are typically trained using a single, well-specified scalar reward function. However, real-world decision-making tasks often involve multiple, competing objectives, such as performance versus efficiency, where ground-truth reward functions are difficult to specify or inaccessible. While Multi-Objective RL (MORL) addresses such trade-offs by modeling rewards as vectors, existing approaches typically assume access to a well-specified reward function for each objective, inheriting the same challenges faced by single-objective RL. Meanwhile, Preference-based RL (PbRL) has shown great potential in solving complex tasks without access to a pre-defined reward function through reward learning from human feedback, yet has largely been studied in single-objective settings. In this work, we bridge this gap with LEMUR: Learning to Align with Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning with Preference feedback, a novel framework where an agent interactively learns from the preferences of multiple humans to learn optimal multi-objective policies. Our approach jointly learns policies and multiple objective-specific reward models from human feedback, enabling agents to effectively balance competing objectives during learning. We evaluate LEMUR on a variety of benchmark multi-objective tasks, and empirical results demonstrate its superior performance over baseline methods. Our method presents a promising direction for solving multi-objective decision-making tasks without pre-defined reward functions.
2607.29559.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習 (RL) 系統通常使用單一、明確指定的標量獎勵函數進行訓練。<lb/>然而，現實世界中的決策任務通常涉及多個相互競爭的目標，例如性能與效率之間的權衡，在這種情況下，真實獎勵函數難以指定或無法獲得。<lb/>雖然多目標強化學習 (MORL) 通過將獎勵建模為向量來解決這些權衡，但現有的方法通常假設對每個目標都有一個明確指定的獎勵函數，繼承了單目標 RL 所面臨的相同挑戰。<lb/>同時，基於偏好的強化學習 (PbRL) 在通過從人類反饋中學習獎勵來解決複雜任務方面顯示出巨大潛力，但主要是在單目標設置中進行研究。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們通過 LEMUR：學習與多目標強化學習對齊的偏好反饋，彌補了這一空白，這是一個新穎的框架，代理可以從多位人類的偏好中互動學習，以學習最佳的多目標策略。<lb/>我們的方法從人類反饋中共同學習策略和多個目標特定的獎勵模型，使代理在學習過程中能夠有效平衡相互競爭的目標。<lb/>我們在各種基準多目標任務上評估 LEMUR，實證結果顯示其性能優於基準方法。<lb/>我們的方法為在沒有預定義獎勵函數的情況下解決多目標決策任務提供了一個有前景的方向。
